profile.headline: Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments
profile.summary:
My background is primarily in embedded systems and data management. I work primarily in C++ and PHP, though I also have experience in Java, Javascript, and C#. I prefer to work in Windows and Linux, I am happy to adapt to new operating systems. I am driven by a desire to be challenged and adapt quickly to find solutions to new problems.
I would like to gain hands-on experience with exciting fields like Artificial Intelligence and Cloud-based networking.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and developed Money Market Surveillance applications used by traders to monitor, organize, and execute trades
Developed automated testing workflows across 17 applications using Cypress, Cucumber, JUnit, and Jest.
Supported 26 applications managing over $1 Trillion under management for the Money Market area in an on-call support role, addressing dozens of high-criticality incidents.
Worked closely with new hires to speed up training to start development within a single sprint of joining our squad.
Built a web app to optimize Treasury auction bids for Money Market funds using AngularJS, Spring Boot, and PL/SQL.
Enhanced real-time updates with Kafka, WebSockets, and caching, delivering faster performance and better UX.
Cut advisor research and preparation time by 50%, and reduced advisors' need to leverage 18 different systems into one dynamic, efficient application.
Work in Agile methodology with bi-weekly sprints and a proper lookup on the burn-down chart.
Developing robust front-end experiences and user-centered products, services, software applications, and platforms at scale using languages such as Angular 5+, React, Typescript, Vanilla JavaScript, HTML 5, CSS3 and Nodejs.
Leading the full UI development process, including planning, analysis, design, coding, user testing, problem debugging, and resolution.
Developed Single Page Application with custom Directives, Services and Filters using Dependency Injection and also worked with ngrx(state,store,effects,action etc) for managing Angular applications.
Analyzing information to determine, recommend, and plan computer software specifications and proposing modifications and improvements based on user needs.
Use JIRA for bug tracking. Git is used as a version control tool, and Jenkins is used for continuous integration and Deployment (CI/CD)
Worked with the team of architects and back-end developers to gather requirements and enhance the application functionality, and add new features.
